tasks.objective_text_zh: 将高阶祭司纳菲塞特的卷轴、高阶祭司塔雷坎的卷轴和高阶祭司安多拉斯的卷轴交给牦牛村的冬风酋长。

tasks.name: 勇猛的进攻

tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 15 En'kilah Ghouls and 5 En'kilah Necromancers and report back to Durm Icehide at Taunka'le Village.

tasks.name: 坦克可不会自己修好！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与加尔鲁什码头的莫布谈一谈。

tasks.name: 战斗仍在继续
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莱洛拉斯希望你进入魔环，营救贝加里斯塔兹与他的同伴。
tasks.objective_text_en: Raelorasz wants you to enter the Oculus and rescue Belgaristrasz and his companions.

tasks.name: 协同作战
tasks.objective_text_zh: 贝加里斯塔兹要求你摧毁10台离心构造体，以此关闭瓦尔洛斯的护盾。然后击败瓦尔洛斯·云击。
tasks.objective_text_en: Belgaristrasz wants you to destroy 10 Centrifuge Constructs to bring down Varos' shield. You then must defeat Varos Cloudstrider.

tasks.name: 法师领主伊洛姆
tasks.objective_text_zh: 贝加里斯塔兹要求你击败魔环的法师领主伊洛姆。
tasks.objective_text_en: Belgaristrasz wants you to defeat Mage-Lord Urom in the Oculus.

tasks.name: 龙翼之力
tasks.objective_text_zh: 贝加里斯塔兹要求你击败魔环的埃雷苟斯，然后回到考达拉的永生之盾，向莱洛拉斯复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Belgaristrasz wants you to kill Eregos in the Oculus and then report to Raelorasz at the Transitus Shield in Coldarra.

tasks.name: 修理项链
tasks.objective_text_zh: 用一颗玉髓石对项链进行修补，然后把它还给达拉然魔法商业区珠宝店的提莫斯·琼斯。
tasks.objective_text_en: Repair the necklace with a single Chalcedony and return it to Timothy Jones in at the Jewelcrafters Shop in the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran.

tasks.name: 黑暗的骚动
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在战场上收集萨鲁法尔的战甲，然后前往北风苔原的战歌要塞，将它交给萨鲁法尔大王。
tasks.objective_text_en: Gather Saurfang's Battle Armor from the field of battle and return it to High Overlord Saurfang at Warsong Hold in Borean Tundra.

tasks.name: 毫无遗憾的一生

tasks.objective_text_en: Take the portal to Undercity located in Grommash Hold and report to Vol'jin.

tasks.name: 科拉丝塔萨

tasks.objective_text_en: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to bring her 5 Bloodtooth Frenzies.

tasks.objective_text_zh: 同孤儿监护员艾蕊娅交谈，然后使用神谕者孤儿哨召唤你要在儿童周照顾的孤儿。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak to Orphan Matron Aria, then use the Oracle Orphan Whistle to call the orphan you will be taking care of during Children's Week.

tasks.name: 伙伴！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 带领你的孤儿鲁鲁前去拜访冬鳍避难所。当你到达那里的时候，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
